source.text: Ὅλως ἀκούεται ἐν ὑμῖν πορνεία, καὶ τοιαύτη πορνεία ἥτις οὐδὲ ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν, ὥστε γυναῖκά τινα τοῦ πατρὸς ἔχειν.

records.literal_gloss: Actually is heard among you sexual immorality, and such sexual immorality which not even among the Gentiles, so as a wife someone of the father to have.

en.L: Actually, sexual immorality is reported among you, and sexual immorality of a kind that [is] not even among the Gentiles, so that someone has [his] father's wife.
en.B: People are actually saying that sexual immorality is going on among you, immorality of a kind that even the Gentiles do not allow: one of you is living with his father's wife.
en.R: People are really saying that there is sexual sin among you. It is a kind of sin that even pagans do not allow. A man in your church is living with his stepmother as if she were his wife.

fr.L: En fait, on entend dire [qu’il y a] parmi vous de l’immoralité sexuelle, et une immoralité sexuelle telle [qu’il n’y en a] même pas parmi les nations, au point que quelqu’un a la femme de [son] père.
fr.B: On entend vraiment dire qu’il y a de l’immoralité sexuelle chez vous, une immoralité que même les non-Juifs ne tolèrent pas : l’un de vous vit avec la femme de son père.
fr.R: On dit vraiment qu’il y a des péchés sexuels chez vous. C’est un péché que même les païens n’acceptent pas. Un homme de votre église vit avec la femme de son père, sa belle-mère, comme si elle était sa femme.

es.L: En efecto, se oye [que hay] entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} inmoralidad sexual, y una inmoralidad sexual tal que ni siquiera [se da] entre los gentiles, a tal punto que alguien tiene la mujer de [su] padre.
es.B: De verdad se dice que hay inmoralidad sexual entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, una inmoralidad de un tipo que ni siquiera los gentiles permiten: uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} vive con la mujer de su padre.
es.R: La gente realmente está diciendo que hay pecado sexual entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Es una clase de pecado que ni siquiera los paganos permiten. Un hombre de la iglesia vive con su madrastra como si fuera su esposa.

sw.L: Kwa kweli inasikika kwamba kuna uasherati kati yenu, tena uasherati wa namna ambayo haupo hata kati ya watu wa mataifa, kwamba mtu fulani anaishi na mke wa baba [yake].
sw.B: Watu wanasema kweli kwamba uasherati unatendeka kati yenu, uasherati wa namna ambayo hata watu wa mataifa hawauruhusu: mmoja wenu anaishi na mke wa baba yake.
sw.R: Kweli watu wanasema kwamba kuna dhambi ya ngono kati yenu. Ni dhambi ambayo hata wapagani hawairuhusu. Mwanamume mmoja katika kanisa lenu anaishi na mama yake wa kambo kama mke wake.

vi.L: Thật vậy, người ta nghe nói có sự tà dâm giữa anh chị em, và là sự tà dâm đến nỗi ngay cả giữa các dân ngoại cũng không có, là có người lấy vợ của cha mình.
vi.B: Người ta thật sự đang nói rằng có sự tà dâm giữa anh chị em, một kiểu tà dâm mà ngay cả dân ngoại cũng không chấp nhận: có người trong anh chị em đang sống với vợ của cha mình.
vi.R: Người ta thật sự đang nói rằng giữa anh chị em có tội tình dục. Đó là loại tội mà ngay cả những người không biết Đức Chúa Trời cũng không chấp nhận. Có một người đàn ông trong Hội Thánh anh chị em đang sống với mẹ kế mình như vợ chồng.

ko.L: 실제로 여러분 가운데 음행이 있다는 말이 들립니다. 그것도 이방 사람들 가운데서도 없는 음행이어서, 어떤 사람이 [자기] 아버지의 아내를 데리고 있다는 것입니다.
ko.B: 여러분 가운데 음행이 있다는 말이 실제로 들립니다. 그것도 이방 사람들조차 용납하지 않는 음행입니다. 여러분 가운데 어떤 사람이 자기 아버지의 아내와 함께 살고 있다는 것입니다.
ko.R: 여러분 가운데 성적인 죄가 있다는 말이 정말로 들려옵니다. 그것은 하나님을 모르는 사람들도 용납하지 않는 죄입니다. 여러분 교회의 어떤 남자가 자기 새어머니를 아내처럼 데리고 살고 있다고 합니다.

pt.L: De fato, ouve-se [falar] de imoralidade sexual entre vocês, e de uma imoralidade sexual tal que nem entre as nações [existe]: que alguém tem a mulher do [seu] pai.
pt.B: Há gente dizendo que existe imoralidade sexual entre vocês, e de um tipo que nem os não judeus admitem: um de vocês está vivendo com a mulher do pai.
pt.R: As pessoas estão mesmo dizendo que há pecado sexual entre vocês. É um tipo de pecado que nem os pagãos aceitam. Um homem da igreja de vocês está vivendo com a madrasta como se ela fosse a mulher dele.

am.L: በእውነት በመካከላችሁ ዝሙት እንዳለ ይሰማል፤ ይህም በአሕዛብ መካከል እንኳ የሌለ ዓይነት ዝሙት ነው፤ ይኸውም አንዱ የአባቱን ሚስት ይዞ መኖሩ ነው።
am.B: በመካከላችሁ ዝሙት እንዳለ ሰዎች በእርግጥ ይናገራሉ፤ ይህም አሕዛብ እንኳ የማይፈቅዱት ዓይነት ዝሙት ነው፤ ከእናንተ አንዱ ከአባቱ ሚስት ጋር ይኖራል።
am.R: በመካከላችሁ የፆታ ኃጢአት እንዳለ ሰዎች በእውነት ይናገራሉ። ይህም እግዚአብሔርን የማያውቁ ሕዝቦች እንኳ የማይፈቅዱት ዓይነት ኃጢአት ነው። በቤተ ክርስቲያናችሁ ያለ አንድ ሰው ከእንጀራ እናቱ ጋር እንደ ሚስቱ ሆኖ ይኖራል።

hi.L: सचमुच तुम्हारे बीच यौन अनैतिकता की चर्चा सुनी जाती है, और ऐसी यौन अनैतिकता जो अन्यजातियों में भी नहीं [होती], कि कोई अपने पिता की पत्नी को रखता है।
hi.B: लोग सचमुच कह रहे हैं कि तुम्हारे बीच यौन पाप हो रहा है, ऐसा यौन पाप जिसे अन्यजाति भी नहीं सहते: तुममें से एक अपने पिता की पत्नी के साथ रह रहा है।
hi.R: लोग सचमुच कह रहे हैं कि तुम्हारे बीच यौन पाप है। यह ऐसा पाप है जिसे ग़ैर-यहूदी लोग भी नहीं सहते। तुम्हारी कलीसिया का एक आदमी अपनी सौतेली माँ के साथ ऐसे रह रहा है मानो वह उसकी पत्नी हो।

ru.L: Вообще, слышно, [что] среди вас блуд, и такой блуд, какого [нет] даже среди язычников, — что кто-то имеет жену отца.
ru.B: О вас говорят, что среди вас действительно есть распутство, и такое распутство, какого не допускают даже язычники: один из вас живёт с женой своего отца.
ru.R: Люди действительно говорят, что среди вас есть сексуальный грех. Это такой грех, которого не позволяют себе даже люди, не знающие Бога. Один мужчина в вашей церкви живёт со своей мачехой, как с женой.

uk.L: Справді, чути серед вас про розпусту, і таку розпусту, якої [немає] навіть серед язичників, що хтось має жінку [свого] батька.
uk.B: Люди справді кажуть, що серед вас коїться розпуста, і така, якої не допускають навіть язичники: один із вас живе з жінкою свого батька.
uk.R: Люди справді кажуть, що серед вас є статевий гріх. Це такий гріх, якого не допускають навіть язичники. Один чоловік у вашій церкві живе зі своєю мачухою, наче з дружиною.

ja.L: 実際、あなたがたの間に淫らな行いがあると聞こえています。しかも、異邦人の間にさえない[ほどの]淫らな行いで、ある人が父の妻を[自分のものとして]持っているというのです。
ja.B: 実は、あなたがたの間で淫らな行いが行われていると、人々が言っています。それは、異邦人でさえ許さないような淫らな行いです。あなたがたの一人が、父親の妻と暮らしているというのです。
ja.R: みなさんの間に性的な罪があると、人々が本当に話しています。それは、神を知らない人たちでさえ許さないような罪です。教会のある男の人が、自分のまま母を妻のようにして暮らしているというのです。

decisions.choice: actually: it is truly so, beyond doubt
decisions.reason: Ὅλως can mean "actually, really" or "generally, everywhere". Either way the report is not a rumor Paul doubts: it is widely known and true. Paul heard it, perhaps from Chloe's people (1:11) or from the visitors of 16:17.

decisions.choice: sexual immorality: sexual relations outside marriage, here a forbidden union within the family
decisions.reason: πορνεία is the general word for sexual sin, as in Colossians 3:5. It is repeated for emphasis: this is not just immorality, but immorality of a particular kind.

decisions.choice: the text without a verb: "not even among the Gentiles"
alternatives: a form with the added verb "is named": "such as is not even named among the Gentiles"
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts add a verb meaning "is named" after "Gentiles", perhaps from Ephesians 5:3; the earlier manuscripts, followed by the SBLGNT, have no verb, and the sense must be supplied ("is found", "is tolerated"). The meaning is the same. This description is from general knowledge; reviewers must check it against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: even the Gentiles: even people outside the people of God, whose morals Jews and Christians thought low, condemned this
alternatives: the nations in general, without any contrast
decisions.reason: Roman law forbade a man to marry his stepmother, even after his father's death, and Greek and Roman writers treated such a union as a scandal. Paul's point is that the church tolerates what its pagan neighbors condemn. ἔθνεσιν here means the non-Jewish world outside the church; the Corinthian believers were themselves mostly Gentiles by birth (12:2).

decisions.choice: his father's wife: most likely his stepmother, the wife of his father but not his own mother
decisions.reason: Paul does not say "his mother". "Father's wife" is the wording of Leviticus 18:8 and Deuteronomy 22:30 (23:1 in the Hebrew), which forbid a man to uncover his father's wife, and Leviticus 20:11 puts the penalty at death. Paul's command in verse 13 echoes Deuteronomy. Whether the father was dead or divorced, and why the woman herself is not addressed (perhaps she was not a believer, compare verses 12-13), is not said.

decisions.choice: has: an ongoing relationship, living with her as a wife
decisions.reason: ἔχειν is a present infinitive, and "to have" a woman was a common way of speaking of marriage or a lasting sexual relationship (7:2; Mark 6:18). The man is living in the relationship, not looking back on a past act.

decisions.choice: is living with (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Has his father's wife" can sound like ownership in English. Balanced and Readable say what the Greek means: an ongoing relationship (m6).

decisions.choice: his stepmother as if she were his wife (R); pagans (R)
decisions.reason: Readable names the relationship plainly (m5) and says "pagans" for the non-Jewish world outside the church, since "Gentiles" is church language and the point is the contrast with outsiders (m4). "A man in your church" makes clear he is one of them ("among you").

decisions.choice: l’immoralité sexuelle (L, B); les péchés sexuels (R) (for this chapter and the vice lists of 5:9-11 and 6:9-10)
decisions.reason: As the English "sexual immorality" and "sexual sin". "Fornication" is church language and today too narrow; "débauche" suggests excess more than forbidden relations.

decisions.choice: la femme de son père, sa belle-mère (R); votre église (R)
decisions.reason: French "belle-mère" means both stepmother and mother-in-law, so Readable keeps "the wife of his father" and adds "belle-mère" to name her (m5). "Église" is lowercase for the congregation at Corinth, as the style guide sets for one local church.

decisions.choice: inmoralidad sexual (L, B); pecado sexual (R)
decisions.reason: As in Galatians 5:19 and Colossians 3:5, Literal and Balanced say "inmoralidad sexual" and Readable "pecado sexual", the same words wherever this word and its family return in the letter (5:9-11; 6:9, 13, 18).

decisions.choice: uasherati (L, B); dhambi ya ngono (R)
decisions.reason: "Uasherati" is sexual immorality in general, as in Swahili Ephesians 5:3, and covers the forbidden union in the family that the meaning decision describes; "zinaa" usually means adultery or fornication in particular. Readable says plainly "dhambi ya ngono" (sexual sin), as the English Readable does. The same words come back in 5:9–11 and 6:9–18.

decisions.choice: "sự tà dâm" (L), "tà dâm" (B), "tội tình dục" (R) for porneia (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: The words of the Vietnamese Galatians 5:19 and Colossians 3:5 for porneia; Readable uses the plain phrase those letters use.

decisions.choice: "những người không biết Đức Chúa Trời" (R) for the Gentiles here; "mẹ kế" (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says who they are, as the English says "pagans"; "mẹ kế" names the stepmother, as m5 reads it.

decisions.choice: "음행" (L, B); "성적인 죄" (R), through the letter
decisions.reason: The words of Ephesians 5:3 and 1 Thessalonians 4:3 for sexual immorality in general; "간음" is kept for adultery.

decisions.choice: "아버지의 아내" (L, B); "새어머니" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the woman as most likely his stepmother, and keeps the wording of Leviticus 18:8; Readable says "stepmother", as the English does.

decisions.choice: imoralidade sexual (L, B); pecado sexual (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as docs/corinthians-terms.md sets the word (m2). "Prostituição", the old rendering, now means selling sex, and "fornicação" is church language; Readable says "pecado sexual", as the English Readable says "sexual sin".

decisions.choice: ዝሙት (sexual immorality, L, B); የፆታ ኃጢአት (sexual sin, R)
decisions.reason: "ዝሙት" is the broad Amharic word for sexual relations outside marriage, which is what the Greek word covers; "ምንዝር" is narrower, unfaithfulness in marriage. Readable says it plainly, as the English does, and the same words are kept wherever the word returns (6:13, 18).

decisions.choice: "यौन अनैतिकता" (L); "यौन पाप" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Porneia is sexual relations outside marriage (meaning decision m2), rendered as in Matthew 15:19 and Mark 7:21; "व्यभिचार" is kept for adultery.

decisions.choice: "अन्यजातियों" (L, B); "ग़ैर-यहूदी" (R)
decisions.reason: The key term for Gentiles at each level. Readable keeps it where the English Readable says "pagans"; the point is people outside God's people (meaning decision m4).

decisions.choice: "के साथ रह रहा है" (B, R); "सौतेली माँ" (R)
decisions.reason: "रखता है" (L) keeps the Greek "has"; Balanced and Readable say it is an ongoing relationship (meaning decision m6), and Readable names the stepmother (m5).

decisions.choice: блуд (L); распутство (B); сексуальный грех (R)
decisions.reason: The word covers sexual relations outside marriage (m2). "Блудодеяние" (Synodal) is archaic, and "прелюбодеяние" is adultery, a narrower word. The same choice holds for the related nouns in verses 9-11.

decisions.choice: язычников (L, B); люди, не знающие Бога (R)
decisions.reason: The key term for the Gentiles at Literal and Balanced. Here the point is the moral standards of the non-Jewish world (m4), so Readable says "people who do not know God" rather than "other peoples".

decisions.choice: розпуста (L, B); статевий гріх (R), for porneia through the letter
decisions.reason: The Corinthians note has "sexual immorality" at Literal and Balanced and "sexual sin" at Readable. "Розпуста" covers every sexual union outside marriage, as m2 says; "перелюб" is adultery only, and "блуд" is an older church word.

decisions.choice: "淫らな行い" (L, B); "性的な罪" (R) for porneia
decisions.reason: As in the Thessalonians drafts; the book keeps one word for porneia throughout.

decisions.choice: "神を知らない人たち" (R) for "the Gentiles"
decisions.reason: The point is moral standards outside God's people (m4); the English Readable says "pagans", as Matthew 5:47 does.

source.text: καὶ ὑμεῖς πεφυσιωμένοι ἐστέ, καὶ οὐχὶ μᾶλλον ἐπενθήσατε, ἵνα ἀρθῇ ἐκ μέσου ὑμῶν ὁ τὸ ἔργον τοῦτο ποιήσας;

records.literal_gloss: And you puffed up are, and not rather you mourned, so that might be taken out of [the] midst of you the [one] the deed this having done?

en.L: And are you puffed up, and did you not rather mourn, so that the one who has done this deed might be taken out of your midst?
en.B: And you are puffed up! Why were you not grieving instead, so that the man who did this would be removed from among you?
en.R: And you are proud of yourselves! You should have been full of sorrow instead. Then you would have put the man who did this out of your church.

fr.L: Et vous, vous êtes enflés [d’orgueil], et vous n’avez pas plutôt pris le deuil, afin que soit ôté du milieu de vous celui qui a fait cette action ?
fr.B: Et vous êtes enflés d’orgueil ! Pourquoi n’avez-vous pas plutôt été dans le deuil, pour que l’homme qui a fait cela soit retiré du milieu de vous ?
fr.R: Et vous êtes fiers de vous ! Vous auriez plutôt dû être remplis de tristesse. Alors vous auriez chassé de votre église l’homme qui a fait cela.

es.L: ¿Y {{plural_you:ustedes están|vosotros estáis}} envanecidos, y no {{plural_you:se lamentaron|os lamentasteis}} más bien, para que fuera quitado de en medio de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} el que hizo esta obra?
es.B: ¡Y {{plural_you:ustedes están|vosotros estáis}} envanecidos! ¿Por qué no {{plural_you:se pusieron|os pusisteis}} más bien de luto, para que el que hizo esto fuera apartado de entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}?
es.R: ¡Y {{plural_you:están|estáis}} orgullosos de {{plural_you:ustedes mismos|vosotros mismos}}! Más bien {{plural_you:deberían|deberíais}} haber estado llenos de tristeza. Entonces {{plural_you:habrían|habríais}} echado de la iglesia al hombre que hizo esto.

sw.L: Nanyi mmevimba kwa kiburi, wala hamkuhuzunika zaidi, ili aliyefanya tendo hili aondolewe kati yenu?
sw.B: Nanyi mmevimba kwa kiburi! Kwa nini hamkuomboleza badala yake, ili mtu aliyefanya jambo hili aondolewe kati yenu?
sw.R: Nanyi mnajiona bora! Mngepaswa kujawa na huzuni badala yake. Hapo mngemtoa nje ya kanisa lenu mtu aliyefanya jambo hili.

vi.L: Thế mà anh chị em vẫn kiêu căng, và lẽ ra anh chị em đã phải than khóc, để người đã làm việc ấy bị loại ra khỏi giữa anh chị em, phải không?
vi.B: Thế mà anh chị em lại kiêu căng! Sao anh chị em không đau buồn thì hơn, để người đã làm điều này bị loại ra khỏi giữa anh chị em?
vi.R: Thế mà anh chị em lại tự hào về mình! Lẽ ra anh chị em phải đầy buồn rầu. Khi đó anh chị em đã đuổi người làm điều này ra khỏi Hội Thánh rồi.

ko.L: 그런데도 여러분은 우쭐해 있습니다. 오히려 슬퍼하여 이 일을 행한 사람을 여러분 가운데서 내쫓았어야 하지 않습니까?
ko.B: 그런데도 여러분은 우쭐해 있습니다! 오히려 슬퍼하며, 이런 일을 한 사람을 여러분 가운데서 내보냈어야 하지 않습니까?
ko.R: 그런데도 여러분은 스스로 자랑스러워하고 있습니다! 여러분은 오히려 깊이 슬퍼했어야 합니다. 그랬다면 이런 일을 한 사람을 교회에서 내보냈을 것입니다.

pt.L: E vocês estão inchados, e não ficaram antes de luto, para que fosse tirado do meio de vocês o que praticou esse ato?
pt.B: E vocês estão cheios de si! Por que não ficaram de luto, em vez disso, para que o homem que fez isso fosse afastado do meio de vocês?
pt.R: E vocês estão orgulhosos de si mesmos! Em vez disso, vocês deviam ter ficado muito tristes. Então teriam expulsado da igreja o homem que fez isso.

am.L: እናንተስ ታብያችኋልን? ይህን ድርጊት የፈጸመው ከመካከላችሁ እንዲወገድ ይልቁንም አላዘናችሁምን?
am.B: እናንተም ታብያችኋል! ይህን ያደረገው ሰው ከመካከላችሁ እንዲወገድ ለምን ይልቁንም አላዘናችሁም?
am.R: እናንተ ደግሞ በራሳችሁ ትኮራላችሁ! ይልቁንም በሐዘን መሞላት ነበረባችሁ። ያን ጊዜ ይህን ያደረገውን ሰው ከቤተ ክርስቲያናችሁ ታስወጡት ነበር።

hi.L: और तुम फूले हुए हो, और तुमने इसके बजाय शोक क्यों नहीं किया, कि जिसने यह काम किया है वह तुम्हारे बीच में से निकाला जाए?
hi.B: और तुम घमंड से फूले हुए हो! तुमने इसके बदले शोक क्यों नहीं किया, ताकि जिस आदमी ने यह किया, वह तुम्हारे बीच से हटा दिया जाए?
hi.R: और तुम अपने आप पर घमंड कर रहे हो! इसके बजाय तुम्हें दुख से भर जाना चाहिए था। तब तुम उस आदमी को, जिसने यह किया, अपनी कलीसिया से बाहर कर देते।

ru.L: И вы раздулись [от гордости], а не стали скорее скорбеть, чтобы из вашей среды был удалён тот, кто совершил это дело?
ru.B: А вы раздуваетесь от гордости! Почему же вы не скорбели, чтобы человек, сделавший это, был удалён из вашей среды?
ru.R: А вы гордитесь собой! Вам следовало бы горевать. Тогда вы удалили бы из своей церкви человека, который это сделал.

uk.L: А ви надулися, і хіба не мали ви радше заплакати, щоб був забраний з-посеред вас той, хто вчинив це діло?
uk.B: А ви надулися гордістю! Чому ви натомість не сумували, щоб того, хто вчинив це, було усунуто з-поміж вас?
uk.R: А ви пишаєтеся собою! Натомість вам слід було глибоко сумувати. Тоді ви вигнали б із церкви чоловіка, який це зробив.

ja.L: それでも、あなたがたは思い上がっているのですか、そして、この行いをした者があなたがたの中から取り除かれるように、むしろ嘆き悲しまなかったのですか？
ja.B: それなのに、あなたがたは思い上がっています！なぜ、むしろ嘆き悲しまなかったのですか？そうすれば、こんなことをした人は、あなたがたの中から取り除かれたはずです。
ja.R: それなのに、みなさんは得意になっています！本当なら、深く悲しむべきだったのです。そうすれば、こんなことをした人を、教会から追い出していたはずです。

decisions.choice: puffed up: inflated with self-importance
decisions.reason: πεφυσιωμένοι is the verb of 4:6, 18-19: arrogance that thinks itself above correction. The perfect tense describes a settled state. Paul does not say whether they were proud in spite of the man's sin or because of it, perhaps as proof of their freedom (compare the slogan of 6:12); either way their pride kept them from dealing with it.

decisions.choice: mourn: grieve as for a death, here grief over sin in the church
decisions.reason: ἐπενθήσατε is the word for mourning the dead. Paul uses it in 2 Corinthians 12:21 for grief over church members who have not repented. Grief, not pride, was the right response to the sin of one of their members, and it would have led them to act.

decisions.choice: so that: the result such mourning should have led to, the man's removal
alternatives: a command: "Let the one who did this be removed"
decisions.reason: ἵνα most naturally gives the purpose or result of the mourning. It is sometimes read as introducing a command, but the sentence reads well as one question, as the SBLGNT punctuates it. Either way Paul wants the man removed.

decisions.choice: the one who did this: the man of verse 1
alternatives: anyone who does such a thing
decisions.reason: The masculine singular participle refers to one particular man, the one living with his father's wife. Like "this man" in 2 Corinthians 2:5-11, it needs no inclusive wording.

decisions.choice: puffed up (B); proud of yourselves (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "puffed up" for this verb throughout the letter; Readable says "proud" (see docs/corinthians-terms.md).

decisions.choice: put ... out of your church
decisions.reason: Readable says what "from your midst" means: removal from the church's fellowship, as verses 5, 11 and 13 explain. The question becomes a plain statement because it expects the answer "you should have".

decisions.choice: enflés [d’orgueil] (L), enflés d’orgueil (B); fiers de vous (R)
decisions.reason: French cannot say "enflés" alone for pride, so the image is completed with "d’orgueil", bracketed at Literal. The same wording is kept for this verb wherever the letter uses it, as the English keeps "puffed up".

decisions.choice: "फूले हुए" (L); "घमंड से फूले हुए" (B); "घमंड" (R)
decisions.reason: The same picture of being puffed up as in 4:6, 18 and 19 (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: раздулись [от гордости] (L); раздуваетесь от гордости (B)
decisions.reason: The same picture as in 4:6 and 4:18-19; Readable says "гордитесь".

decisions.choice: заплакати
decisions.reason: m2 says the word is grief as for a death. Literal "заплакати" keeps the mourning; Balanced and Readable say "сумувати".

source.text: Ἐγὼ μὲν γάρ, ἀπὼν τῷ σώματι παρὼν δὲ τῷ πνεύματι, ἤδη κέκρικα ὡς παρὼν τὸν οὕτως τοῦτο κατεργασάμενον ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ, συναχθέντων ὑμῶν καὶ τοῦ ἐμοῦ πνεύματος σὺν τῇ δυνάμει τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ, παραδοῦναι τὸν τοιοῦτον τῷ Σατανᾷ εἰς ὄλεθρον τῆς σαρκός, ἵνα τὸ πνεῦμα σωθῇ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ κυρίου.

records.literal_gloss: I indeed for, being absent in the body but being present in the spirit, already have judged as being present the [one] so this having done, \v 4 in the name of the Lord of us Jesus, having been gathered you and the my spirit with the power of the Lord of us Jesus, \v 5 to hand over the such [one] to Satan for destruction of the flesh, so that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord.

en.L: For I, though absent in the body but present in the spirit, have already judged, as being present, the one who has done this in such a way. \v 4 In the name of our Lord Jesus, when you and my spirit have been gathered together with the power of our Lord Jesus, \v 5 [you are] to hand over such a one to Satan for [the] destruction of the flesh, so that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord.
en.B: As for me, I am away in body but there in spirit, and I have already reached my verdict on the man who has done such a thing, as surely as if I were with you. \v 4 When you are gathered together in the name of our Lord Jesus, and my spirit is with you, together with the power of our Lord Jesus, \v 5 this man is to be handed over to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, with the aim that on the day of the Lord his spirit may be saved.
en.R: I am not there with you in person, but my spirit is with you. I have already made my judgment about the man who did this, as though I were present. \v 4 Meet together in the name of our Lord Jesus. I will be with you in spirit, and the power of our Lord Jesus will be there too. \v 5 Then you must hand this man over to Satan. Put him out of the church, so that the sinful desires that rule him will be destroyed, and so that he himself will be saved on the day the Lord comes back.

fr.L: Car moi, absent de corps mais présent d’esprit, j’ai déjà jugé, comme si j’étais présent, celui qui a ainsi commis cela. \v 4 Au nom de notre Seigneur Jésus, vous et mon esprit étant rassemblés avec la puissance de notre Seigneur Jésus, \v 5 [vous devez] livrer un tel [homme] à Satan pour la destruction de la chair, afin que l’esprit soit sauvé au jour du Seigneur.
fr.B: Quant à moi, je suis absent de corps mais présent en esprit, et j’ai déjà rendu mon jugement sur celui qui a commis un tel acte, aussi sûrement que si j’étais parmi vous. \v 4 Lorsque vous serez réunis au nom de notre Seigneur Jésus, et que mon esprit sera avec vous, avec la puissance de notre Seigneur Jésus, \v 5 cet homme doit être livré à Satan pour la destruction de la chair, afin que son esprit soit sauvé au jour du Seigneur.
fr.R: Je ne suis pas avec vous en personne, mais mon esprit est avec vous. J’ai déjà pris ma décision au sujet de l’homme qui a fait cela, comme si j’étais là. \v 4 Réunissez-vous au nom de notre Seigneur Jésus. Je serai avec vous en esprit, et la puissance de notre Seigneur Jésus sera là, elle aussi. \v 5 Alors vous devrez livrer cet homme à Satan. Chassez-le de l’église, pour que les désirs mauvais qui le dominent soient détruits, et pour que lui-même soit sauvé le jour où le Seigneur reviendra.

es.L: Porque yo, ciertamente, ausente en el cuerpo pero presente en el espíritu, ya he juzgado, como si estuviera presente, al que de tal manera ha hecho esto. \v 4 En el nombre de nuestro Señor Jesús, reunidos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y mi espíritu, con el poder de nuestro Señor Jesús, \v 5 [{{plural_you:deben|debéis}}] entregar a ese tal a Satanás para destrucción de la carne, a fin de que el espíritu sea salvo en el día del Señor.
es.B: En cuanto a mí, estoy ausente en el cuerpo pero presente en espíritu, y ya he dictado mi sentencia sobre el hombre que ha hecho tal cosa, tan seguro como si estuviera con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. \v 4 Cuando {{plural_you:estén|estéis}} reunidos en el nombre de nuestro Señor Jesús, y mi espíritu esté con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, junto con el poder de nuestro Señor Jesús, \v 5 ese hombre ha de ser entregado a Satanás para la destrucción de la carne, con el fin de que su espíritu sea salvo en el día del Señor.
es.R: Yo no estoy allí con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en persona, pero mi espíritu está con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Ya he tomado mi decisión sobre el hombre que hizo esto, como si estuviera presente. \v 4 {{plural_you:Reúnanse|Reuníos}} en el nombre de nuestro Señor Jesús. Yo estaré con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en espíritu, y el poder de nuestro Señor Jesús también estará allí. \v 5 Entonces {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} entregar a ese hombre a Satanás. {{plural_you:Échenlo|Echadlo}} de la iglesia, para que los deseos pecaminosos que lo dominan sean destruidos, y para que él mismo sea salvo el día en que el Señor regrese.

sw.L: Kwa maana mimi, nisiyekuwepo kimwili lakini niliyepo kiroho, tayari nimeshamhukumu, kana kwamba nipo, mtu aliyetenda jambo hili kwa namna hii. \v 4 Katika jina la Bwana wetu Yesu, mtakapokusanyika, ninyi na roho yangu, pamoja na nguvu ya Bwana wetu Yesu, \v 5 [mnapaswa] kumkabidhi mtu wa namna hiyo kwa Shetani kwa ajili ya uharibifu wa mwili, ili roho iokolewe katika siku ya Bwana.
sw.B: Kwa upande wangu, niko mbali kimwili lakini nipo kiroho, na tayari nimetoa hukumu yangu juu ya mtu aliyefanya jambo kama hili, kwa uhakika kana kwamba nipo pamoja nanyi. \v 4 Mtakapokusanyika pamoja katika jina la Bwana wetu Yesu, na roho yangu ikiwa pamoja nanyi, pamoja na nguvu ya Bwana wetu Yesu, \v 5 mtu huyu akabidhiwe kwa Shetani kwa ajili ya uharibifu wa mwili, kwa lengo kwamba katika siku ya Bwana roho yake iokolewe.
sw.R: Siko pamoja nanyi kimwili, lakini roho yangu iko pamoja nanyi. Tayari nimeshatoa hukumu yangu juu ya mtu aliyefanya jambo hili, kana kwamba nipo. \v 4 Kusanyikeni pamoja katika jina la Bwana wetu Yesu. Mimi nitakuwa pamoja nanyi kiroho, na nguvu ya Bwana wetu Yesu itakuwepo pia. \v 5 Kisha mkabidhini mtu huyu kwa Shetani. Mtoeni nje ya kanisa, ili tamaa za dhambi zinazomtawala ziangamizwe, naye mwenyewe aokolewe siku ile Bwana atakaporudi.

vi.L: Vì về phần tôi, dù vắng mặt về thân thể nhưng có mặt về tâm linh, tôi đã xét xử, như là có mặt, người đã làm việc ấy như vậy. \v 4 Nhân danh Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu, khi anh chị em và tâm linh tôi họp lại cùng với quyền năng của Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu, \v 5 [anh chị em phải] phó người như thế cho Sa-tan để xác thịt bị hủy diệt, hầu cho tâm linh được cứu trong ngày của Chúa.
vi.B: Về phần tôi, dù vắng mặt về thân thể nhưng có mặt về tâm linh, tôi đã đưa ra phán quyết về người đã làm điều như thế, chắc chắn như thể tôi đang ở với anh chị em. \v 4 Khi anh chị em nhóm lại trong danh Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu, và tâm linh tôi ở với anh chị em, cùng với quyền năng của Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu, \v 5 thì người này phải bị phó cho Sa-tan để xác thịt bị hủy diệt, nhằm mục đích để tâm linh người ấy được cứu trong ngày của Chúa.
vi.R: Tôi không có mặt ở đó với anh chị em, nhưng tâm linh tôi ở với anh chị em. Tôi đã đưa ra phán quyết về người đã làm điều này, như thể tôi đang ở đó. \v 4 Hãy nhóm họp với nhau trong danh Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu. Tâm linh tôi sẽ ở với anh chị em, và quyền năng của Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu cũng sẽ ở đó. \v 5 Rồi anh chị em phải giao người này cho Sa-tan. Hãy đuổi người ấy ra khỏi Hội Thánh, để những ham muốn tội lỗi đang cai trị người ấy bị tiêu diệt, và để chính người ấy được cứu vào ngày Chúa trở lại.

ko.L: 나는 몸으로는 떠나 있으나 영으로는 함께 있어서, 이미 함께 있는 것처럼 이런 일을 한 사람을 판결하였습니다. \v 4 우리 주 예수의 이름으로 여러분과 나의 영이 우리 주 예수의 능력과 함께 모였을 때, \v 5 [여러분은] 이런 사람을 사탄에게 넘겨주어 육신은 멸망하게 하고, 그 영은 주님의 날에 구원을 받게 해야 합니다.
ko.B: 나는 몸으로는 떨어져 있지만 영으로는 여러분과 함께 있습니다. 그래서 나는 여러분과 함께 있는 것처럼 이런 일을 한 그 사람에 대해 이미 판결을 내렸습니다. \v 4 여러분이 우리 주 예수의 이름으로 모이고 나의 영도 우리 주 예수의 능력과 함께 거기에 있을 때, \v 5 이 사람을 사탄에게 넘겨주어 그의 육신이 멸망하게 하십시오. 그것은 주님의 날에 그의 영이 구원을 받게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.R: 나는 몸으로는 여러분과 함께 있지 않지만, 내 영은 여러분과 함께 있습니다. 나는 마치 거기에 있는 것처럼, 이런 일을 한 그 사람에 대해 이미 판단을 내렸습니다. \v 4 우리 주 예수의 이름으로 함께 모이십시오. 내 영도 여러분과 함께 있을 것이고, 우리 주 예수의 능력도 거기에 있을 것입니다. \v 5 그때 여러분은 이 사람을 사탄에게 넘겨주어야 합니다. 그를 교회에서 내보내십시오. 그래서 그를 지배하는 죄의 욕망이 없어지게 하고, 주님께서 다시 오시는 날에 그 사람 자신은 구원을 받게 하십시오.

pt.L: Pois eu, embora ausente no corpo, mas presente no espírito, já julguei, como se estivesse presente, aquele que assim cometeu isso. \v 4 Em nome do nosso Senhor Jesus, reunidos vocês e o meu espírito, com o poder do nosso Senhor Jesus, \v 5 [vocês devem] entregar esse tal a Satanás para [a] destruição da carne, a fim de que o espírito seja salvo no dia do Senhor.
pt.B: Quanto a mim, estou longe no corpo, mas presente no espírito, e já dei o meu veredicto sobre o homem que fez tal coisa, tão certo como se estivesse com vocês. \v 4 Quando vocês estiverem reunidos em nome do nosso Senhor Jesus, e o meu espírito estiver com vocês, junto com o poder do nosso Senhor Jesus, \v 5 esse homem deve ser entregue a Satanás para a destruição da carne, a fim de que o espírito dele seja salvo no dia do Senhor.
pt.R: Não estou aí com vocês em pessoa, mas o meu espírito está com vocês. Já fiz o meu julgamento sobre o homem que fez isso, como se eu estivesse presente. \v 4 Reúnam-se em nome do nosso Senhor Jesus. Eu estarei com vocês em espírito, e o poder do nosso Senhor Jesus também estará ali. \v 5 Então vocês devem entregar esse homem a Satanás. Expulsem esse homem da igreja, para que os desejos pecaminosos que o dominam sejam destruídos, e para que ele mesmo seja salvo no dia em que o Senhor voltar.

am.L: እኔ በአካል ብለይም በመንፈስ ግን ከእናንተ ጋር ስለ ሆንኩ፣ እንደ ተገኘኩ ሆኜ ይህን በዚህ ሁኔታ ባደረገው ላይ አስቀድሜ ፈርጃለሁ። \v 4 በጌታችን በኢየሱስ ስም እናንተና መንፈሴ ከጌታችን ከኢየሱስ ኃይል ጋር በተሰበሰባችሁ ጊዜ፣ \v 5 እንደዚህ ያለውን ሰው ለሥጋ ጥፋት ለሰይጣን [ልትሰጡት ይገባል]፤ ይኸውም መንፈሱ በጌታ ቀን እንዲድን ነው።

hi.L: क्योंकि मैं, देह में दूर होते हुए भी पर आत्मा में उपस्थित होकर, मानो उपस्थित होकर, उस पर जिसने ऐसा यह काम किया है, पहले ही न्याय कर चुका हूँ। \v 4 हमारे प्रभु यीशु के नाम में, जब तुम और मेरी आत्मा हमारे प्रभु यीशु की सामर्थ्य के साथ इकट्ठे हों, \v 5 [तुम] ऐसे व्यक्ति को शरीर के विनाश के लिए शैतान को सौंप दो, ताकि प्रभु के दिन आत्मा उद्धार पाए।

hi.R: मैं शरीर से तुम्हारे साथ नहीं हूँ, पर मेरी आत्मा तुम्हारे साथ है। जिस आदमी ने यह किया है, उसके बारे में मैं अपना फ़ैसला पहले ही कर चुका हूँ, मानो मैं वहाँ मौजूद हूँ। \v 4 हमारे प्रभु यीशु के नाम में इकट्ठे हो। मैं आत्मा में तुम्हारे साथ रहूँगा, और हमारे प्रभु यीशु की सामर्थ्य भी वहाँ होगी। \v 5 तब तुम्हें इस आदमी को शैतान को सौंप देना है। उसे कलीसिया से बाहर कर दो, ताकि उसका पापी शारीरिक स्वभाव नष्ट हो जाए, और प्रभु के लौटने के दिन वह स्वयं उद्धार पाए।

ru.B: Что до меня, то я отсутствую телом, но присутствую духом и уже вынес приговор тому, кто совершил такое, так же верно, как если бы я был с вами. \v 4 Когда вы соберётесь во имя нашего Господа Иисуса и мой дух будет с вами, вместе с силой нашего Господа Иисуса, \v 5 этого человека нужно предать сатане на погибель плоти, чтобы в день Господа его дух был спасён.
ru.R: Меня нет с вами телом, но мой дух с вами. Я уже вынес решение о человеке, который это сделал, как будто я был рядом. \v 4 Соберитесь вместе во имя нашего Господа Иисуса. Я буду с вами духом, и сила нашего Господа Иисуса тоже будет там. \v 5 Тогда вы должны предать этого человека сатане. Удалите его из церкви, чтобы его греховная природа, которая им владеет, была уничтожена, а сам он был спасён в день, когда Господь вернётся.

Я буду з вами духом, і сила нашого Господа Ісуса теж буде там. \v 5 Тоді ви мусите віддати цього чоловіка сатані. ja.L: わたしは、体では離れていても霊ではそこにいて、そこにいる者として、このようなことをした者をすでに裁きました。\v 4 わたしたちの主イエスの名によって、あなたがたとわたしの霊が、わたしたちの主イエスの力と共に集まったとき、\v 5 このような者を、肉の滅びのためにサタンに引き渡すのです。それは、霊が主の日に救われるためです。
ja.B: わたしは、体では離れていても、霊ではあなたがたと共にいます。そして、その場にいるのと同じように、こんなことをした人について、すでに判決を下しました。\v 4 あなたがたがわたしたちの主イエスの名によって集まり、わたしの霊もそこに共にいて、わたしたちの主イエスの力も共にあるとき、\v 5 この人をサタンに引き渡すべきです。それは肉が滅ぼされるためであり、主の日にその人の霊が救われるためです。
ja.R: わたしは、体ではみなさんといっしょにいませんが、霊ではいっしょにいます。そして、その場にいるかのように、こんなことをした人について、もう判断を下しました。\v 4 わたしたちの主イエスの名によって集まってください。わたしも霊でみなさんといっしょにいます。わたしたちの主イエスの力も、そこにあります。\v 5 そのとき、この人をサタンに引き渡さなければなりません。教会から追い出すのです。そうすれば、この人を支配している罪の欲望が滅ぼされ、主が戻って来られる日に、この人自身が救われるでしょう。

decisions.choice: in the spirit, my spirit: Paul's own spirit, really present with the church as it meets
decisions.reason: πνεύματι is set against σώματι ("in the body"), as in Colossians 2:5. Paul means more than that he is thinking of them: when the church gathers, he counts himself present, and his judgment stands as if he were there in person. The Holy Spirit is not meant here; Paul says "my spirit" in verse 4.

decisions.choice: in the name of our Lord Jesus: goes with the gathering of the church
alternatives: with "the one who has done this", as if he claimed the Lord's name for his conduct
decisions.reason: The phrase stands between the verdict (verse 3) and the gathering, and could belong to either, or to the handing over in verse 5. Jesus promised to be present where believers gather in his name (Matthew 18:20), and the church acts here as a body under his authority. Each reading gives the action the same authority, but the Greek does not settle which words the phrase belongs to.

decisions.choice: with the power of our Lord Jesus: the Lord's power is present and at work when the church acts
alternatives: power that the church itself exercises
decisions.reason: σὺν ("with") goes with the gathering: the church, Paul's spirit and the Lord's power are all present together. The verdict is carried out by the church, but its force comes from the Lord.

decisions.choice: to hand over: the content of Paul's verdict, to be carried out by the gathered church
alternatives: Paul hands him over by himself
decisions.reason: The infinitive παραδοῦναι depends on "I have judged" in verse 3: Paul's decision is that the man be handed over. Verse 4 says this happens when the church is gathered, and verses 2, 7 and 13 tell the church itself to act.

decisions.choice: hand over to Satan: put him out of the church into the world outside, where Satan holds sway
alternatives: a curse that brings sickness or death directly
handing him to Satan for punishment without hope
decisions.reason: The church is the place where Christ rules; outside it is the realm of "the god of this age" (2 Corinthians 4:4; compare Colossians 1:13). Being put out of the fellowship (verses 2, 13) leaves the man exposed to Satan. Paul uses the same words in 1 Timothy 1:20, where the aim is that the men may learn, and in Job 2:6 God allows Satan to afflict Job but sets a limit. The aim here too is the man's rescue.

decisions.choice: destruction of the flesh: the man's sinful self, which lives for its desires, brought to an end
alternatives: suffering or death of his body
the flesh as human standards or status, as elsewhere in these chapters
decisions.reason: σαρκός here is set against "the spirit" that is to be saved, which suggests the whole person as turned toward sin (as in Galatians 5:24, "those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh"). Many read it instead as physical suffering, perhaps even death (compare 11:30, where sickness and death come as the Lord's discipline). ὄλεθρον is a strong word for ruin, which may favor the physical sense. It is not the sense "human standards" used in 1:26; here flesh is what the man's sin has made of him. The evidence is close, so a footnote gives the other reading.

decisions.choice: the spirit: the man's own spirit, the man himself as he will stand before God
alternatives: the spirit of the church, kept pure
decisions.reason: The man is the subject of the whole verse, so "the spirit" is most naturally his spirit, as "the flesh" is his flesh. Paul expects him to be saved: the discipline aims at his rescue, not his ruin (compare 2 Corinthians 2:6-8). A few read it as the church's spirit, but nothing in the verse prepares for that.

decisions.choice: "our Lord Jesus" (twice) and "the day of the Lord", as in the SBLGNT
alternatives: forms that add "Christ" after "Jesus" in verse 4
forms that add "Jesus" or "our Lord Jesus Christ" in verse 5
decisions.reason: Manuscripts differ on how fully the Lord's name is given in both verses, and later copies tend to fill out titles. The SBLGNT has the shorter forms. The meaning is not affected. This description is from general knowledge; reviewers must check it against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: the day of the Lord: the day of Jesus' coming and judgment
decisions.reason: As in 1:8, the prophets' "day of the Lord" (Amos 5:18; Joel 2:31) is the day of the Lord Jesus. Paul looks beyond the present discipline to the final judgment.

decisions.choice: for the destruction of the flesh (B)
alternatives: so that his sinful nature may be destroyed
so that his body may be destroyed
decisions.reason: Balanced does not use "by human standards", its usual wording for flesh in these letters (docs/corinthians-terms.md), because here the word means something else (m6). It keeps "flesh" so that the reader can see the contrast with "spirit" and the reading the footnote gives.

decisions.choice: Put him out of the church, so that the sinful desires that rule him will be destroyed
alternatives: hand him over to Satan to destroy his flesh
decisions.reason: Readable says what handing over to Satan meant in practice (m5) and gives the sense of "flesh" chosen in m6. That sense is uncertain, and the footnote gives the other reading.

decisions.choice: his spirit (B); he himself (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek says "the spirit"; the article points to the man's own spirit (m7). Readable says "he himself", since in English "his spirit" can sound like one part of him.

decisions.choice: Meet together ... I will be with you in spirit ... Then you must hand this man over
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the long Greek sentence into short ones and states as instructions what the Greek gives as Paul's verdict to be carried out by the gathered church (m4).

decisions.choice: la destruction de la chair (L, B)
alternatives: la destruction de sa nature pécheresse (B)
decisions.reason: "La chair", the style guide's word for this term at Literal and Balanced, is kept at both, as the English Balanced keeps "flesh" here, so that the contrast with "l’esprit" stays visible; the uncertain sense (m6) is left to the footnote.

decisions.choice: destrucción de la carne
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "carne", as the English keeps "flesh", because the meaning decision reads it as the man's sinful self (m6), the sense "carne" has in Galatians 5 and Romans 8. Readable says what it means: the sinful desires that rule him.

decisions.choice: kukabidhi
decisions.reason: "Kukabidhi" (hand over) is the settled word for this Greek verb in the Gospels; it keeps the sense of handing someone into another's power, which the meaning decision explains as putting him out of the church.

decisions.choice: mwili ... roho (lowercase)
decisions.reason: "Mwili" (flesh) and "roho" (spirit) here are the man's sinful self and the man himself (meaning decisions), so "roho" is lowercase with the agreement of a thing, as with Paul's own spirit in verses 3–4; the capital is kept for God's Spirit.

decisions.choice: "tâm linh tôi", "tâm linh người ấy", lowercase, for the human spirit
decisions.reason: As in 2:11: the human spirit is "tâm linh", kept apart from the Holy Spirit. "Tinh thần" would make Paul's presence only a way of speaking, and m1 says it is real.

decisions.choice: "để xác thịt bị hủy diệt" (L, B); "để những ham muốn tội lỗi đang cai trị người ấy bị tiêu diệt" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "xác thịt", the word for sarx, which here means the man's sinful self (m6), not his body; Readable says so, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "사탄에게 넘겨주다" at every level; "육신은 멸망하게 하다" (L, B); "그를 지배하는 죄의 욕망이 없어지게 하다" (R)
decisions.reason: "사탄" is the name in the Gospels and Romans 16:20; "넘겨주다" the verb of Romans 1:24. The meaning decision reads "the flesh" as the man's sinful self, so Literal and Balanced keep "육신", the letter's word for the flesh, and Readable says what is meant, as the English does.

decisions.choice: para a destruição da carne
alternatives: para que a sua natureza pecaminosa seja destruída
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps "carne" here, not the book's usual "pelos padrões humanos" (1:26), because the word means something else in this verse (m6), as the English Balanced also keeps "flesh".

decisions.choice: በአካል (in the body); ለሥጋ ጥፋት (for the destruction of the flesh, L, B)
decisions.reason: Paul uses two words: the body, meaning his bodily presence, and the flesh, meaning the man's sinful self. Amharic keeps them apart, "አካል" and "ሥጋ", so "ሥጋ" still points to the same word as in 1:26 and 3:1-3; Readable explains it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "शरीर" (L, B); "पापी शारीरिक स्वभाव" (R)
decisions.reason: Flesh (sarx) keeps the key term "शरीर" at Literal and Balanced; here it means the man's sinful self (meaning decision m6), so Readable uses "शारीरिक स्वभाव", as the brief allows where the sense is moral. "देह" is kept for the body (sōma) in verse 3, as in Romans 6-8 where flesh is in the context.

decisions.choice: "मेरी आत्मा" (feminine)
decisions.reason: Paul's own spirit (meaning decision m1) takes the ordinary feminine agreement, as in Romans 1:9, so that it is not taken for God's Spirit.

decisions.choice: духом; мой дух; дух (small letter)
decisions.reason: These are Paul's own spirit and the man's spirit (m1, m7), not God's Spirit, so "дух" keeps a small letter.

decisions.choice: плоти (L, B); его греховная природа (R)
decisions.reason: The key term for flesh: "плоть" at Literal and Balanced; at Readable, where the sense is moral, "греховная природа", as in Romans 8 (m6).

decisions.choice: знищення тіла
decisions.reason: As in Romans, sarx is "тіло" at Literal and Balanced; m6 says it is the man's sinful self, which Readable spells out as "грішні бажання".

decisions.choice: "肉の滅び" (L); "肉が滅ぼされる" (B); "この人を支配している罪の欲望が滅ぼされ" (R)
decisions.reason: Follows m6 (uncertain): the man's sinful self, not his body; Readable explains it as the English does.

decisions.choice: vantardise (L); fierté (B); être fiers (R)

decisions.choice: gloriarse (L); orgullo (B); orgullosos (R)

decisions.choice: "자랑" (L); "자랑하다" (B); "자랑스러워하다" (R)

decisions.choice: leaven: a piece of old fermented dough kept back from the last batch and worked into the new
decisions.reason: Bread was raised with ζύμη, a lump of sour dough saved from earlier baking. A small piece spread through the whole new batch. In Jewish teaching it often stood for corruption (Matthew 16:6; Galatians 5:9), and at Passover all of it had to be cleared out (Exodus 12:15, 19).

decisions.choice: a proverb: a small evil left alone spreads through the whole community
decisions.reason: Paul uses the same saying in Galatians 5:9. Here the one man's sin, and the church's pride in tolerating it, will affect the whole church if it is not dealt with. The question expects the answer "yes, we know".

decisions.choice: yeast, makes ... rise (B, R); leaven (L)
decisions.reason: "Leaven" is little used today. Balanced and Readable say "yeast", which works the same way in the picture; Literal keeps "leaven" and the repeated verb "leavens".

decisions.choice: You know that
decisions.reason: Readable turns the question into the statement it expects.

decisions.choice: le levain, faire lever (every level, 5:6-8)
decisions.reason: The English Balanced and Readable say "yeast" because "leaven" is little used. French "levain" is still an everyday word, and it is exactly what m1 describes: fermented dough kept back from the last batch. "Levure" would name a modern product. So French keeps one word at every level.

decisions.choice: levadura; leuda (L), hace fermentar (B), hace que crezca (R)
decisions.reason: Spanish has one word, "levadura", for both the English "leaven" and "yeast", so every level says "levadura", as Galatians 5:9 does. Literal keeps the matching verb "leudar".

decisions.choice: chachu (L); hamira (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Swahili Galatians 5:9, which quotes the same proverb: "chachu" (leaven, a piece of fermented dough) at Literal and "hamira" (yeast), the everyday word, at Balanced and Readable, as the English has leaven and yeast.

decisions.choice: "men" at every level for zyme (also 5:7-8)
decisions.reason: "Men" is the word of the Vietnamese Galatians 5:9, which quotes the same proverb, and it is the plain word for leaven and yeast alike.

decisions.choice: "누룩" for leaven and yeast at every level, through verses 6-8; "반죽" for the dough
decisions.reason: "누룩" is the Korean word for a leavening agent, and covers both the English "leaven" (L) and "yeast" (B, R); it is also the word of the Gospels for the parable of the leaven.

decisions.choice: fermento (every level); leveda (L); faz crescer (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (5:6-8): Portuguese "fermento" covers both the old leaven of m1 and modern yeast, so one word serves every level where the English needs "leaven" and "yeast". Literal keeps the related verb "levedar"; Balanced and Readable say "fazer crescer".

decisions.choice: እርሾ (leaven, yeast) at every level
alternatives: a different word for Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: Amharic has one everyday word for leaven and yeast, "እርሾ", the piece of old dough kept back to start the next batch, as every Ethiopian kitchen keeps for injera. So the English difference between Literal "leaven" and Balanced "yeast" does not arise.

decisions.choice: "ख़मीर"
decisions.reason: The style guide's word for leaven at every level (section 7b); it is the ordinary Hindi word for what makes dough rise, so Hindi needs no change between Literal "leaven" and Balanced "yeast".

decisions.choice: закваска
decisions.reason: As settled in Matthew, "закваска" at every level: it is the right word for a piece of old fermented dough (m1), which the English "yeast" only approximates.

decisions.choice: закваска at every level
decisions.reason: The style guide's word for leaven. m1 says it is a piece of old fermented dough kept back from the last batch, which is exactly Ukrainian "закваска"; "дріжджі", the English "yeast", is bought yeast and would lose the old-and-new picture of verse 7.

decisions.reason: As in Galatians 5:9; "パン種" also fits the Passover picture of 5:7-8.

decisions.choice: clean out the old leaven: as Jewish households removed every bit of leaven before Passover
alternatives: a general call to be clean
decisions.reason: Before Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread, all leaven had to be removed from the house (Exodus 12:15, 19; 13:7). ἐκκαθάρατε means to clean out thoroughly. The old leaven is the evil Paul has described, and the pride that let it stay.

decisions.choice: become what you are: they are already unleavened, made new, and must live like it
alternatives: they are unleavened only once they have cleaned out the leaven
decisions.reason: ἐστε is a statement: they already are unleavened, a new people through Christ (verse 7b; 6:11). The command to clear out the old is based on what God has already made them. Paul often joins what believers are with what they must become (Colossians 3:3-5).

decisions.choice: every trace (B); every bit (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable bring out the thoroughness of the compound verb (m1).

decisions.choice: which is what you really are (B); that is what you already are (R)
decisions.reason: "Unleavened" is folded into "dough without yeast", and the closing clause is made a separate statement so that the point of m2 is clear.

decisions.choice: Literal puts "just as you are unleavened" first, as the reason ("누룩 없는 사람들이니")
alternatives: the clause last, as in the Greek
decisions.reason: Korean puts a reason before the command; the meaning decision reads the clause as the ground of the command, so Literal keeps that link, and Balanced and Readable keep the Greek order with a sentence of their own.

decisions.choice: Passover: the Passover lamb
decisions.reason: πάσχα can mean the festival or the lamb killed for it. With "was sacrificed" it means the lamb (Mark 14:12; Luke 22:7).

decisions.choice: Christ is the Passover lamb, whose death sets God's people free
decisions.reason: At the first Passover the blood of the lamb protected Israel, and God brought them out of Egypt (Exodus 12:21-27). Jesus died at Passover time, and John's Gospel presents him as the lamb whose bones were not broken (John 1:29; 19:36). Paul's logic follows the festival calendar: the lamb was killed after the leaven had been cleared out, so now that the lamb is sacrificed, there is no place for leaven.

decisions.choice: "our Passover lamb was sacrificed", as in the SBLGNT
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts add "for us" after the verb; earlier manuscripts, followed by the SBLGNT, do not have it. The meaning is close. This description is from general knowledge; reviewers must check it against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: Christ has been sacrificed as our Passover lamb (B)
alternatives: our Passover lamb has been sacrificed, Christ
decisions.reason: The Greek holds back "Christ" to the end for emphasis. Balanced puts him first so the sentence reads naturally; Readable explains the Passover lamb, and "for us" gives the sense of "our".

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} at every level
decisions.reason: French needs the article with the title in either option, so Literal writes it too, outside the span, as Colossians does. "La Pâque", singular, names the Jewish feast, never "Pâques".

decisions.choice: "Lễ Vượt Qua" with "chiên con" (L in brackets, B), "con chiên" (R)
decisions.reason: "Lễ Vượt Qua" is the style guide's name for Passover; Paul means the lamb of that feast (m1), which Literal brackets. "Lễ Phục Sinh" is the Easter feast and would blur the allusion.

decisions.choice: "유월절" for Passover; "유월절 [양]" (L), "유월절 어린양" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "유월절" is the Protestant word of the Gospels. The meaning decision reads the word as the Passover lamb, which Literal brackets and Balanced and Readable say.

decisions.choice: "मसीह" with no christos setting
decisions.reason: "मसीह" is both the familiar name and the word Messiah itself, so the choice the English setting offers is already made (style guide, section 7). The same through this chapter.

decisions.choice: "मसीह" after "फ़सह [का मेमना]"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "Christ" at the end, as the Greek holds it back for emphasis; Hindi lets the name stand in apposition before the verb.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Христос|Мессия}}
decisions.reason: The title setting, as through the letter.

decisions.choice: пасхальный ягнёнок (B); ягнёнок, которого закалывают на праздник Пасхи (R)
decisions.reason: "Пасха" here means the Passover lamb (m1); Literal keeps the bare word, Balanced and Readable say "lamb".

records.literal_gloss: So that let us celebrate, not with leaven old nor with leaven of malice and wickedness, but with unleavened [things] of sincerity and truth.

en.L: So let us celebrate the festival, not with old leaven, nor with [the] leaven of malice and wickedness, but with [the] unleavened [bread] of sincerity and truth.
en.B: So let us keep the festival, not with old yeast, nor with yeast that is malice and wickedness, but with bread made without yeast: sincerity and truth.
en.R: So let us keep the feast. Let us not keep it with old yeast, the yeast of wanting to hurt others and doing evil. Let us keep it with bread that has no yeast in it: pure hearts and the truth.

fr.L: Ainsi, célébrons la fête, non avec du vieux levain, ni avec [le] levain de la malice et de la méchanceté, mais avec les [pains] sans levain de la sincérité et de la vérité.
fr.B: Célébrons donc la fête, non avec du vieux levain, ni avec le levain de la malice et de la méchanceté, mais avec le pain sans levain : la sincérité et la vérité.
fr.R: Alors célébrons la fête. Ne la célébrons pas avec du vieux levain, le levain de l’envie de nuire aux autres et des mauvaises actions. Célébrons-la avec du pain sans levain : des cœurs purs et la vérité.

es.L: Así que celebremos la fiesta, no con levadura vieja ni con levadura de malicia y de maldad, sino con [panes] sin levadura de sinceridad y de verdad.

es.R: Así que celebremos la fiesta. No la celebremos con levadura vieja, la levadura de querer hacer daño a otros y de hacer el mal. Celebrémosla con pan que no tiene levadura: corazones limpios y la verdad.

ja.L: ですから、祭りを祝おうではありませんか。古いパン種や、悪意と邪悪のパン種によってではなく、純真と真理の、パン種の入っていない[パン]によって。
ja.B: ですから、祭りを守りましょう。古いパン種や、悪意と邪悪というパン種を使わずに、パン種の入っていないパン、つまり純真さと真理によって。
ja.R: ですから、祭りを祝いましょう。古いイーストを使ってはいけません。人を傷つけようとする心や、悪い行いというイーストです。イーストの入っていないパンで祝いましょう。それは、きよい心と真理です。

decisions.choice: celebrate the festival: the whole of Christian life, lived as an ongoing Passover feast
decisions.reason: ἑορτάζωμεν is a present subjunctive: let us go on keeping the feast. Since Christ the Passover lamb has been sacrificed (verse 7), the life of his people is the festival that follows, and it should have no leaven in it. Paul's subject is the church's life, not one meal or one season.

decisions.choice: malice and wickedness: the wish to harm and active evil
alternatives: two words for the same thing
decisions.reason: κακίας is ill will, the wish to hurt others, as in Colossians 3:8; πονηρίας is wickedness in action. Together they describe the old leaven of verse 7.

decisions.choice: sincerity and truth: purity of motive, with nothing mixed in, and truthfulness
decisions.reason: εἰλικρινείας is purity, being without hidden motives (2 Corinthians 1:12; 2:17). ἀληθείας here is truth lived out, honesty in life as well as word. These are the unleavened bread of the feast: life with nothing corrupt mixed in.

decisions.choice: unleavened: unleavened bread (or loaves), as at the Feast of Unleavened Bread
decisions.reason: ἀζύμοις is a plural adjective with no noun; at Passover it means the unleavened loaves (Mark 14:1).

decisions.choice: bread made without yeast (B); bread that has no yeast in it (R)
decisions.reason: Following the choice of "yeast" in verse 6, and avoiding the old word "unleavened".

decisions.choice: wanting to hurt others and doing evil; pure hearts
decisions.reason: Readable puts the vice and virtue words in everyday terms, as Colossians 3:8 does for malice, and keeps "truth", a key term.

decisions.choice: "누룩 없는 [빵]" (L); "누룩 없는 빵" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The style guide gives "빵" for bread, never "떡"; "무교병" is the older church word.

decisions.choice: "지킵시다" (-ㅂ시다) for "let us"
decisions.reason: Paul includes himself; the polite "let us" of 합쇼체 is "-ㅂ시다".

decisions.choice: ቂጣ (unleavened bread)
decisions.reason: "ቂጣ" is the ordinary Amharic word for bread made without leaven, the bread of the Passover week, so Amharic can name it in one word where Literal English supplies "[bread]".

decisions.choice: "सत्य" (L, B); "सच" (R)
decisions.reason: The style guide's key term for truth at each level.

decisions.choice: пресном [хлебе] (L); хлебом без закваски (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Опресноки" (Synodal) is a church word; the plain words keep the link with "закваска".

decisions.choice: истины (L, B); правдой (R)
decisions.reason: The style guide's key term for truth.

source.text: Ἔγραψα ὑμῖν ἐν τῇ ἐπιστολῇ μὴ συναναμίγνυσθαι πόρνοις, οὐ πάντως τοῖς πόρνοις τοῦ κόσμου τούτου ἢ τοῖς πλεονέκταις καὶ ἅρπαξιν ἢ εἰδωλολάτραις, ἐπεὶ ὠφείλετε ἄρα ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου ἐξελθεῖν.

records.literal_gloss: I wrote to you in the letter not to mix with sexually immoral, \v 10 not altogether with the sexually immoral of the world this or with the greedy and swindlers or idolaters, since you were obliged then out of the world to go out.

en.L: I wrote to you in the letter not to mix with sexually immoral [people], \v 10 not altogether [meaning] the sexually immoral of this world, or the greedy and swindlers, or idolaters, since then you would be obliged to go out of the world.
en.B: When I wrote to you in my earlier letter, I told you not to mix with sexually immoral people. \v 10 I did not mean the sexually immoral people of this world in general, nor the greedy and swindlers, nor idolaters. To do that, you would need to leave the world altogether.
en.R: In the letter I wrote you before, I told you not to spend time with people who commit sexual sins. \v 10 But I did not mean people outside the church, all the people in the world who commit sexual sins, or who are greedy and cheat others, or who worship idols. To keep away from all of them, you would have to leave the world!

fr.L: Je vous ai écrit dans la lettre de ne pas avoir de relations avec des débauchés, \v 10 non pas absolument [avec] les débauchés de ce monde, ou les cupides et les escrocs, ou les idolâtres, puisqu’alors vous devriez sortir du monde.
fr.B: Dans ma lettre précédente, je vous ai écrit de ne pas fréquenter les débauchés. \v 10 Je ne parlais pas des débauchés de ce monde en général, ni des cupides et des escrocs, ni des idolâtres : pour cela, il vous faudrait quitter complètement le monde.
fr.R: Dans la lettre que je vous ai écrite avant celle-ci, je vous ai dit de ne pas fréquenter les gens qui commettent des péchés sexuels. \v 10 Mais je ne parlais pas des gens qui sont hors de l’église, de tous ceux qui, dans le monde, commettent des péchés sexuels, ou qui sont avides et trompent les autres, ou qui adorent des idoles. Pour vous tenir loin de tous ces gens, il faudrait que vous quittiez le monde !

es.L: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} escribí en la carta que no {{plural_you:se juntaran|os juntarais}} con [los] sexualmente inmorales, \v 10 no [me refería] en absoluto a los sexualmente inmorales de este mundo, o a los avaros y estafadores, o a los idólatras, ya que en ese caso {{plural_you:tendrían|tendríais}} que salir del mundo.
es.B: Cuando {{plural_you:les|os}} escribí en mi carta anterior, {{plural_you:les|os}} dije que no {{plural_you:se juntaran|os juntarais}} con personas sexualmente inmorales. \v 10 No me refería a las personas sexualmente inmorales de este mundo en general, ni a los avaros y estafadores, ni a los idólatras. Para eso {{plural_you:tendrían|tendríais}} que salir del mundo por completo.
es.R: En la carta que {{plural_you:les|os}} escribí antes, {{plural_you:les|os}} dije que no {{plural_you:pasaran|pasarais}} tiempo con personas que cometen pecados sexuales. \v 10 Pero no me refería a la gente de fuera de la iglesia, a todas las personas del mundo que cometen pecados sexuales, o que son avaras y estafan a otros, o que adoran ídolos. ¡Para {{plural_you:mantenerse|manteneros}} lejos de todos ellos, {{plural_you:tendrían|tendríais}} que salir del mundo!

sw.L: Niliwaandikia katika barua ile msishirikiane na waasherati, \v 10 si kabisa [nikimaanisha] waasherati wa ulimwengu huu, au wenye tamaa ya mali na walaghai, au waabudu sanamu, kwa maana hapo ingewalazimu kutoka nje ya ulimwengu.
sw.B: Nilipowaandikia katika barua yangu ya awali, niliwaambia msishirikiane na waasherati. \v 10 Sikumaanisha waasherati wa ulimwengu huu kwa ujumla, wala wenye tamaa ya mali na walaghai, wala waabudu sanamu. Kufanya hivyo kungewalazimu kuondoka ulimwenguni kabisa.
sw.R: Katika barua niliyowaandikia hapo awali, niliwaambia msikae pamoja na watu wanaofanya dhambi za ngono. \v 10 Lakini sikumaanisha watu walio nje ya kanisa, yaani watu wote ulimwenguni wanaofanya dhambi za ngono, au walio na tamaa ya mali na kuwadanganya wengine, au wanaoabudu sanamu. Ili kujitenga nao wote, mngelazimika kuondoka ulimwenguni!

vi.L: Trong thư, tôi đã viết cho anh chị em là đừng giao du với những kẻ tà dâm, \v 10 không hoàn toàn [có ý nói] những kẻ tà dâm của thế gian này, hoặc những kẻ tham lam và những kẻ lừa đảo, hoặc những kẻ thờ thần tượng, vì nếu vậy anh chị em phải ra khỏi thế gian.
vi.B: Trong lá thư trước, tôi đã viết bảo anh chị em đừng giao du với những người tà dâm. \v 10 Tôi không có ý nói chung về những người tà dâm của thế gian này, hay những người tham lam và lừa đảo, hay những người thờ thần tượng. Muốn vậy, anh chị em phải ra khỏi thế gian luôn.
vi.R: Trong lá thư trước, tôi đã bảo anh chị em đừng giao du với những người phạm tội tình dục. \v 10 Nhưng tôi không có ý nói về những người ở ngoài Hội Thánh, tức là tất cả những người trong thế gian phạm tội tình dục, hoặc tham lam và lừa gạt người khác, hoặc thờ thần tượng. Muốn tránh xa tất cả những người ấy, anh chị em phải rời khỏi thế gian!

ko.L: 내가 그 편지에서 여러분에게 음행하는 사람들과 어울리지 말라고 썼습니다. \v 10 그것은 이 세상의 음행하는 사람들이나 탐욕을 부리는 사람들과 남의 것을 빼앗는 사람들이나 우상을 숭배하는 사람들과 전혀 [사귀지 말라는 뜻이] 아니었습니다. 그렇다면 여러분은 세상 밖으로 나가야 할 것입니다.
ko.B: 내가 전에 보낸 편지에서 여러분에게 음행하는 사람들과 어울리지 말라고 썼습니다. \v 10 그것은 이 세상에 있는 음행하는 사람들이나, 탐욕을 부리는 사람들과 남의 것을 빼앗는 사람들이나, 우상을 숭배하는 사람들을 모두 멀리하라는 뜻이 아니었습니다. 그렇게 하려면 여러분은 이 세상을 아예 떠나야 할 것입니다.
ko.R: 내가 전에 쓴 편지에서 성적인 죄를 짓는 사람들과 어울리지 말라고 여러분에게 말했습니다. \v 10 그러나 그것은 교회 밖에 있는 사람들, 곧 이 세상에서 성적인 죄를 짓는 모든 사람이나, 욕심이 많아 남을 속이는 사람들이나, 우상을 섬기는 사람들을 말한 것이 아니었습니다. 그런 사람들을 모두 멀리하려면 여러분은 이 세상을 떠나야 할 것입니다!

pt.L: Escrevi a vocês na carta que não se misturassem com [pessoas] sexualmente imorais, \v 10 não [me referindo] de modo geral aos sexualmente imorais deste mundo, ou aos gananciosos e trapaceiros, ou aos idólatras, pois nesse caso vocês teriam de sair do mundo.
pt.B: Quando escrevi a vocês na minha carta anterior, eu lhes disse que não se misturassem com pessoas sexualmente imorais. \v 10 Eu não estava falando dos sexualmente imorais deste mundo em geral, nem dos gananciosos e trapaceiros, nem dos idólatras. Para isso, vocês precisariam sair do mundo de uma vez.
pt.R: Na carta que escrevi a vocês antes, eu disse que não andassem com pessoas que cometem pecados sexuais. \v 10 Mas eu não estava falando das pessoas de fora da igreja, de todas as pessoas do mundo que cometem pecados sexuais, ou que são gananciosas e enganam os outros, ou que adoram ídolos. Para ficar longe de todas elas, vocês teriam de sair do mundo!

am.L: በዚያ መልእክት ከሴሰኞች ጋር እንዳትደባለቁ ጻፍኩላችሁ፤ \v 10 ይህም ፈጽሞ የዚህን ዓለም ሴሰኞች ወይም ስግብግቦችንና አጭበርባሪዎችን ወይም ጣዖት አምላኪዎችን ማለቴ አይደለም፤ እንዲህማ ቢሆን ከዓለም መውጣት ባስፈለጋችሁ ነበር።
am.B: በቀድሞው መልእክቴ ከሴሰኞች ጋር እንዳትቀላቀሉ ጽፌላችሁ ነበር። \v 10 በአጠቃላይ የዚህን ዓለም ሴሰኞች፣ ስግብግቦችንና አጭበርባሪዎችን ወይም ጣዖት አምላኪዎችን ማለቴ አልነበረም። ይህንማ ለማድረግ ከዓለም ፈጽሞ መውጣት ያስፈልጋችሁ ነበር።
am.R: ከዚህ በፊት በጻፍኩላችሁ ደብዳቤ የፆታ ኃጢአት ከሚፈጽሙ ሰዎች ጋር ጊዜ እንዳታሳልፉ ነግሬአችሁ ነበር። \v 10 ነገር ግን ከቤተ ክርስቲያን ውጭ ያሉትን ሰዎች ማለቴ አልነበረም፤ በዓለም ያሉትን የፆታ ኃጢአት የሚፈጽሙትን፣ ስግብግቦችንና ሌሎችን የሚያታልሉትን፣ ወይም ጣዖትን የሚያመልኩትን ሁሉ ማለቴ አልነበረም። ከሁሉም ለመራቅ ከዓለም መውጣት ባለባችሁ ነበር!

hi.L: मैंने अपने पत्र में तुम्हें लिखा था कि यौन अनैतिक [लोगों] से मेल-जोल न रखना, \v 10 यह नहीं कि बिलकुल इस संसार के यौन अनैतिक [लोगों] से, या लोभियों और ठगों से, या मूर्तिपूजकों से, क्योंकि तब तो तुम्हें संसार से ही निकल जाना पड़ता।
hi.B: जब मैंने तुम्हें अपने पिछले पत्र में लिखा, तो मैंने कहा था कि यौन अनैतिक लोगों से मेल-जोल न रखो। \v 10 मेरा मतलब आम तौर पर इस संसार के यौन अनैतिक लोगों से नहीं था, न लोभियों और ठगों से, न मूर्तिपूजकों से। ऐसा करने के लिए तो तुम्हें संसार को ही छोड़ना पड़ता।
hi.R: मैंने पहले जो पत्र तुम्हें लिखा था, उसमें मैंने कहा था कि यौन पाप करनेवालों के साथ समय न बिताओ। \v 10 पर मेरा मतलब कलीसिया के बाहर के लोगों से नहीं था, यानी संसार के उन सब लोगों से जो यौन पाप करते हैं, या लालची हैं और दूसरों को ठगते हैं, या मूर्तियों की पूजा करते हैं। उन सब से दूर रहने के लिए तो तुम्हें संसार ही छोड़ना पड़ता!

ru.L: Я писал вам в письме, чтобы вы не смешивались с блудниками, \v 10 [имея в виду] не вообще блудников этого мира, или жадных и грабителей, или идолопоклонников, ведь тогда вам пришлось бы уйти из мира.
ru.B: Когда я писал вам в прежнем письме, я велел вам не водиться с распутниками. \v 10 Я не имел в виду распутников этого мира вообще, или жадных и мошенников, или идолопоклонников. Для этого вам пришлось бы совсем уйти из мира.
ru.R: В письме, которое я писал вам раньше, я говорил вам не проводить время с людьми, которые совершают сексуальные грехи. \v 10 Но я не имел в виду людей вне церкви, всех людей в мире, которые совершают сексуальные грехи, или жадничают и обманывают других, или поклоняются идолам. Чтобы держаться подальше от них всех, вам пришлось бы уйти из этого мира!

uk.L: Я писав вам у листі не єднатися з розпусниками, \v 10 не взагалі з розпусниками цього світу, чи з жадібними і здирниками, чи з ідолопоклонниками, бо тоді ви мусили б вийти зі світу.
uk.B: Коли я писав вам у попередньому листі, я сказав вам не водитися з розпусними людьми. \v 10 Я не мав на увазі розпусників цього світу загалом, ані жадібних і здирників, ані ідолопоклонників. Інакше вам довелося б зовсім вийти зі світу.
uk.R: У листі, який я писав вам раніше, я сказав вам не проводити часу з людьми, які чинять статеві гріхи. \v 10 Але я не мав на увазі людей поза церквою, усіх людей у світі, які чинять статеві гріхи, або жадібних, які обманюють інших, або тих, хто поклоняється ідолам. Щоб триматися подалі від усіх них, вам довелося б покинути світ!

ja.L: わたしは手紙の中で、淫らな者たちと交わらないようにと書きました。\v 10 [それは]この世の淫らな者たち、あるいは貪欲な者たちやだまし取る者たち、あるいは偶像礼拝者たちと、まったく[交わるな]という[意味]ではありません。それなら、あなたがたは世から出て行かなければならないでしょう。
ja.B: 以前の手紙で、わたしはあなたがたに、淫らな者たちと付き合わないようにと書きました。\v 10 それは、この世の淫らな者たち全般や、貪欲な者たち、だまし取る者たち、偶像礼拝者たちのことではありません。そうするためには、この世から出て行かなければならないでしょう。
ja.R: 前に書いた手紙で、わたしはみなさんに、性的な罪を犯す人たちと付き合わないようにと書きました。\v 10 でもそれは、教会の外の人たちのことではありません。この世で性的な罪を犯すすべての人たちや、欲ばりな人たち、人をだます人たち、偶像を拝む人たちのことではないのです。その人たち全員を避けようとすれば、この世から出て行くしかありません！

decisions.choice: the letter: an earlier letter of Paul's, now lost
alternatives: this present letter, written in the same breath
decisions.reason: "I wrote to you in the letter" points to a letter the Corinthians already had. Verse 11, "but now I write", sets this one against it, and the Corinthians had misunderstood the earlier instruction. That letter has not survived. The Corinthians later wrote to Paul (7:1).

decisions.choice: mix with: keep company with, share a common life
decisions.reason: συναναμίγνυσθαι means to mingle together with others. Verse 11 shows what is meant: close fellowship in the church, including eating together. Paul did not ask the church to avoid all contact with outsiders, which would be impossible (verse 10).

decisions.choice: the world: human society outside the church, which does not know God
decisions.reason: κόσμου here is the whole social world the Corinthians lived in, with its pagan ways (1:20-21; 3:19). To leave it would mean leaving human life on earth. The church is not to judge such people (verses 12-13).

decisions.choice: the greedy and swindlers, or idolaters: people who grab more than their share, people who take by force or fraud, and worshipers of other gods
decisions.reason: πλεονέκταις are the covetous, who always want more (compare Colossians 3:5); ἅρπαξιν are those who seize what belongs to others, by robbery or by cheating. Joined by "and", the two form one group of money sins. εἰδωλολάτραις are those who worship idols, which pagan Corinth did everywhere (8:1-10; 10:14-22). The same words return in 5:11 and 6:9-10.

decisions.choice: in my earlier letter (B)
decisions.reason: Balanced makes clear that "the letter" is not this one (m1). Readable says "the letter I wrote you before".

decisions.choice: I did not mean people outside the church
alternatives: not altogether the sexually immoral of this world
decisions.reason: Readable says who "the immoral of this world" are: people outside the church (m3), set against the "brother" of verse 11.

decisions.choice: sexually immoral, greedy, swindlers, idolaters (L, B); commit sexual sins, greedy, cheat others, worship idols (R)
decisions.reason: The same English is used for these words in 5:11 so that the reader can see the lists are the same. "Fornicators" and "extortioners" are little used today; "swindlers" covers both theft and cheating.

decisions.choice: débauchés, cupides, escrocs, idolâtres (L, B); qui commettent des péchés sexuels, qui sont avides, qui trompent les autres, qui adorent des idoles (R); the same words in 5:11 and 6:9-10
decisions.reason: One French word for each Greek term, kept wherever the lists recur, as the English does. "Débauché" is the plain modern noun for a person who lives in sexual immorality; "impudique" is dated. "Escroc" covers taking by fraud, as the English "swindler" does; "avare" would mean a miser rather than one who grabs more than his share.

decisions.choice: sexualmente inmorales, avaros, estafadores, idólatras (L, B); cometen pecados sexuales, son avaros, estafan a otros, adoran ídolos (R)
decisions.reason: The vice list (here, 5:11 and 6:9-10) keeps the same Spanish words each time it returns, as the English does. Verse 11 adds "insultador" (one who insults) and "borracho"; Readable says "insultan a la gente" and "se emborrachan".

decisions.choice: waasherati, wenye tamaa ya mali, walaghai, waabudu sanamu (L, B); wanaofanya dhambi za ngono, walio na tamaa ya mali, kuwadanganya wengine, wanaoabudu sanamu (R)
decisions.reason: The vice list in the same words wherever it recurs (5:11; 6:9–10). "Walaghai" (swindlers, cheats) covers taking by fraud as well as force (meaning decision); "wanyang'anyi" (robbers) is kept for the Gospels' bandits. "Wazinzi" would narrow the first word to adulterers.

decisions.choice: the vice list: "kẻ tà dâm, kẻ tham lam, kẻ lừa đảo, kẻ thờ thần tượng, kẻ chửi rủa, kẻ say sưa" (L); the same words with "người" (B); "phạm tội tình dục, tham lam, lừa gạt người khác, thờ thần tượng, sỉ nhục người khác, say rượu" (R), in the same words wherever the list recurs (5:11; 6:9-10)
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Ephesians 5:5: Literal says "kẻ" for those named in a list of sins, Balanced the more neutral "người". The same words come back each time, so the reader sees one list. Harpax is one who takes by force or fraud (m4); "lừa đảo" (swindler) is the English choice.

decisions.choice: the vice list as "음행하는 사람, 탐욕을 부리는 사람, 남의 것을 빼앗는 사람, 우상을 숭배하는 사람" (L, B) and "성적인 죄를 짓는 사람, 욕심이 많은 사람, 남을 속이는 사람, 우상을 섬기는 사람" (R), in the same words in verse 11 and 6:9-10
decisions.reason: The list recurs, so it keeps the same words wherever it comes back. The words describe what people do; "남의 것을 빼앗는 사람" covers taking by force or by fraud, as the meaning decision says, where "토색하는 자" is an older word few readers know.

decisions.choice: sexualmente imorais, gananciosos, trapaceiros, idólatras (L, B); cometem pecados sexuais, são gananciosos, enganam os outros, adoram ídolos (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the vice list keeps the same Portuguese wherever it recurs (5:10-11; 6:9-10), as docs/corinthians-terms.md asks, with "insultador" and "beberrão" for the two words added in verse 11. "Devassos", "avarentos" and "roubadores" are old-fashioned; "trapaceiro" covers both cheating and taking by fraud, as "swindler" does.

decisions.choice: ሴሰኞች, ስግብግቦች, አጭበርባሪዎች, ጣዖት አምላኪዎች (L, B); የፆታ ኃጢአት የሚፈጽሙ, ስግብግቦች, ሌሎችን የሚያታልሉ, ጣዖትን የሚያመልኩ (R)
decisions.reason: The vice list keeps the same Amharic words wherever it recurs (5:11; 6:9-10), as the book's terms note sets for the English. The Greek word for swindlers covers taking by fraud as well as by force, so "አጭበርባሪ" (cheat) is used rather than "ቀማኛ" (robber).

decisions.choice: "यौन अनैतिक", "लोभी", "ठग", "मूर्तिपूजक" (L, B); "यौन पाप करते हैं", "लालची", "दूसरों को ठगते हैं", "मूर्तियों की पूजा करते हैं" (R)
decisions.reason: The vice list keeps the same Hindi words wherever it recurs (verse 11; 6:9-10), so the reader can see it is the same list. "व्यभिचारी" is kept for adulterers (6:9).

decisions.choice: грабителей (L); мошенников (B); обманывают других (R)
decisions.reason: "Хищник" (Synodal) now means a beast of prey. The same words are used in verse 11 so that the two lists can be compared.

decisions.choice: розпусники, жадібні, здирники, ідолопоклонники, лихослови, пʼяниці (L, B); чинять статеві гріхи, жадібні, обманюють інших, поклоняються ідолам, ображають людей, напиваються (R): the same words wherever the list returns (5:11; 6:9-10)
decisions.reason: The Corinthians note fixes one wording per level for the vice lists. "Здирник" is one who takes from others by pressure or fraud (m4), the English "swindler"; "лихослов" one who reviles others.

source.text: νῦν δὲ ἔγραψα ὑμῖν μὴ συναναμίγνυσθαι ἐάν τις ἀδελφὸς ὀνομαζόμενος ᾖ πόρνος ἢ πλεονέκτης ἢ εἰδωλολάτρης ἢ λοίδορος ἢ μέθυσος ἢ ἅρπαξ, τῷ τοιούτῳ μηδὲ συνεσθίειν.

records.literal_gloss: Now but I wrote to you not to mix, if anyone [a] brother being called is sexually immoral or greedy or idolater or reviler or drunkard or swindler, with the such [one] not even to eat with.

en.L: But now I write to you not to mix [with anyone], if anyone who is called a {{gender:brother or sister|brother}} is sexually immoral or greedy or an idolater or abusive or a drunkard or a swindler; with such a person not even to eat.
en.B: But what I am writing to you now is this: keep away from anyone who goes by the name of {{gender:brother or sister|brother}} and yet is sexually immoral, greedy, an idolater, abusive, a drunkard or a swindler. Do not even sit down to eat with such a person.
en.R: Now I am writing to tell you this: do not spend time with someone who is known as a fellow believer but commits sexual sins or is greedy, or who worships idols, insults people, gets drunk or cheats others. Do not even eat a meal with a person like that.

fr.L: Mais maintenant je vous écris de ne pas avoir de relations [avec quelqu’un], si quelqu’un qui porte le nom de {{gender:frère ou sœur|frère}} est débauché, ou cupide, ou idolâtre, ou injurieux, ou ivrogne, ou escroc ; avec quelqu’un de tel, ne pas même manger.
fr.B: Mais voici ce que je vous écris maintenant : ne fréquentez pas quelqu’un qui porte le nom de {{gender:frère ou sœur|frère}} et qui est pourtant débauché, cupide, idolâtre, injurieux, ivrogne ou escroc. Ne vous mettez même pas à table avec quelqu’un de tel.
fr.R: Maintenant, je vous écris pour vous dire ceci : ne fréquentez pas quelqu’un qui se dit croyant, s’il commet des péchés sexuels, s’il est avide, s’il adore des idoles, s’il insulte les gens, s’il s’enivre ou s’il trompe les autres. Ne prenez même pas un repas avec une telle personne.

es.L: Pero ahora {{plural_you:les|os}} escribo que no {{plural_you:se junten|os juntéis}} [con nadie] que, llamándose hermano, sea sexualmente inmoral, o avaro, o idólatra, o insultador, o borracho, o estafador; con ese tal ni siquiera comer.
es.B: Pero lo que ahora {{plural_you:les|os}} escribo es esto: {{plural_you:apártense|apartaos}} de cualquiera que se llame hermano y sin embargo sea sexualmente inmoral, avaro, idólatra, insultador, borracho o estafador. Con alguien así ni siquiera {{plural_you:se sienten|os sentéis}} a comer.
es.R: Ahora {{plural_you:les|os}} escribo para {{plural_you:decirles|deciros}} esto: no {{plural_you:pasen|paséis}} tiempo con alguien que dice ser creyente pero comete pecados sexuales o es avaro, o que adora ídolos, insulta a la gente, se emborracha o estafa a otros. Ni siquiera {{plural_you:coman|comáis}} con una persona así.

sw.L: Lakini sasa nawaandikia msishirikiane [na mtu yeyote], ikiwa mtu anayeitwa ndugu ni mwasherati, au mwenye tamaa ya mali, au mwabudu sanamu, au mtukanaji, au mlevi, au mlaghai; na mtu wa namna hiyo msile hata pamoja naye.
sw.B: Lakini ninachowaandikia sasa ni hiki: jitengeni na mtu yeyote anayejiita ndugu na bado ni mwasherati, au mwenye tamaa ya mali, au mwabudu sanamu, au mtukanaji, au mlevi, au mlaghai. Msiketi hata kula pamoja na mtu wa namna hiyo.
sw.R: Sasa nawaandikia kuwaambia hivi: msikae pamoja na mtu anayejulikana kama mwamini mwenzenu, lakini anafanya dhambi za ngono, au ana tamaa ya mali, au anaabudu sanamu, au anawatukana watu, au analewa, au anawadanganya wengine. Msile hata chakula pamoja na mtu wa namna hiyo.

vi.L: Nhưng bây giờ tôi viết cho anh chị em là đừng giao du [với ai], nếu có người được gọi là {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} mà là kẻ tà dâm, hoặc kẻ tham lam, hoặc kẻ thờ thần tượng, hoặc kẻ chửi rủa, hoặc kẻ say sưa, hoặc kẻ lừa đảo; với người như thế thì ngay cả ăn chung cũng đừng.
vi.B: Nhưng điều tôi viết cho anh chị em bây giờ là: hãy tránh xa người nào mang danh là {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} mà lại là người tà dâm, tham lam, thờ thần tượng, chửi rủa, say sưa hay lừa đảo. Ngay cả ngồi ăn chung với người như thế cũng đừng.
vi.R: Bây giờ tôi viết để nói với anh chị em điều này: đừng giao du với người nào được biết là một tín hữu nhưng lại phạm tội tình dục, hoặc tham lam, hoặc thờ thần tượng, sỉ nhục người khác, say rượu hay lừa gạt người khác. Ngay cả một bữa ăn cũng đừng ăn chung với người như vậy.

ko.L: 그러나 이제 내가 여러분에게 쓰는 것은, {{gender:형제자매|형제}}라고 불리는 사람이 음행하는 사람이거나 탐욕을 부리는 사람이거나 우상을 숭배하는 사람이거나 남을 모욕하는 사람이거나 술 취하는 사람이거나 남의 것을 빼앗는 사람이면, 그런 사람과는 어울리지 말고 함께 먹지도 말라는 것입니다.
